description: Standing jobs: register a digest for the paying wallet with a cadence (hourly, daily, weekly or interval), an optional start_at, a callback_url and an expires_at up to 30 days ahead. Each window collects the wallet’s Wever Watch fires and standing-job results recorded while it was open (sources: watch_fires, job_results or both) and posts one signed digest report to callback_url. Windows with nothing to report are posted only with include_empty: true. One call covers every window until the digest ends. POST /api/digest-create. Standing jobs check and report: they run read-and-report Wever tools only and never move money, place orders or change state. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Every call carries X-Wever-Wallet-Proof bound to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route; a paid call adds Payment-Signature from the same wallet. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/standing-jobs-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/standing-jobs/.

cadence.description: hourly, daily, weekly, or interval with interval_seconds.

callback_url.description: Public HTTPS URL that receives one signed digest report per window as a JSON POST.

expires_at.description: When the schedule ends, up to 30 days ahead. No run starts at or after this time.

include_empty.description: true posts a digest for windows with nothing to report. Defaults to false.

interval_seconds.description: Seconds between runs when cadence is interval: 900 (15 minutes) to 604800 (7 days).

label.description: Optional name shown in lists, reports and digests.

start_at.description: Optional first run or window start. Defaults to the first whole minute at least 60 seconds after the call. Later runs follow this anchor.
